reuse.why: Extends the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter and threads it through the existing callers, rather than writing a new mover.

duplication.why: The 'weekend or holiday' daily-skip predicate is written out twice (getDatesInRange and getNextDate) instead of one isNonWorkingDay helper, next to the identical check inside getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

placement.why: The moving rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the weekend rule already lives; the per-site daily-skip checks stay in their callers as before.

scope.why: Only the type field, the shared mover, its callers and two tests.

maintainability.why: The holiday notion is spread over three inline checks and one call path (budget schedule-template.ts) still calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays, so the rule is easy to apply inconsistently; getNextDate's fixed take=4 window also ignores holidays.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated holidays?.includes(dayFromDate(...)) checks in app.ts getDatesInRange and shared/schedules.ts getNextDate are plain repetitions, not disguised.

one_place.where: Moving lands in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the daily-skip holiday check is duplicated in server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange and shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, and server/budget/schedule-template.ts still calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays.
